snippet.title: Battleborn: Phoebe and the Heart of Ekkunar
snippet.description:
Why would the Battleborn venture into dangerous Aztanti ruins? FOR SCIENCE! Join the Battleborn in unlocking the mysteries of the Varelsi, the ancient Aztanti and the place beyond the portals in the fifth DLC Story Operation “Phoebe and the Heart of Ekkunar.”

Command 30 unique heroes and save the universe from the brink of extinction! Fight alone or alongside friends, play story missions or mow down foes in competitive multiplayer matches.  

From the creators of Borderlands comes Battleborn, a new first-person shooter for every kind of badass available on now for the PlayStation 4, PC, and Xbox One. 

Battleborn is rated T for TEEN (Language, Violence). For more information about Battleborn, visit http://battleborn.com.
